Appointments Made by the Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Province

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by the Article154C of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic ofSri Lanka, it is hereby notified that I, Marshall Perera, Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, under theSection (3) of the part I of the Establishment of the Development Construction and Machinery Authority of theSabaragamuwa Provincial Council Statute No. 02 of 2009 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, appointed thefollowing persons as Chairman/ Member of the Director Board of the Sabaragamuwa Province Development Constructionand Machinery Authority which is established by the said Statute, with effect from 30.11.2017.

01.Mr. P. Sunil Premachandra-Chairman02.Mrs. Sriyani Padmalatha-Member of the Director Board03.Mr. J. M. D. Wijayaraja-Member of the Director Board04.Mr. A. M. Gnanasena-Member of the Director Board05.Mr. A. D. K. A. Weerarathna-Member of the Director Board06.Mr. Parakrama Piyasena-Member of the Director Board07.Mr. P. Wijesighe-Member of the Director Board
